maria-partners: quick sync — we need a clear SI co-sell and lead mapping for our upcoming joint announcement with NucleiCloud + marketplace listing. who owns which accounts and what's the SLA? cc @priya-si @sophia-sales

dan-eng: for infra-heavy deals (on-prem, HSM, custom infra) route to SI. also route when projected ACV > 100k. keep hosted/cloud-only low-touch with sales.

alex-sdr: can we add a field in SFDC so we don't double-claim? something like `nuclei_partner_tag` + `si_opt_in` checkbox.

sophia-sales: agree. propose: SI auto-claim if `nuclei_partner_tag == true` OR ACV >= 250k OR hw_deployed == true. Sales keeps net-new where tag absent.

maria-partners: +1. also want a lightweight intro template for PR / joint demos. draft below:

```
Subject: Joint announcement sync — NucleiCloud + Redwood
Hi <SI contact>,
We're announcing marketplace listing on <DATE>. Can we do 30m to align on demos, logos, and lead triage?
Attendees: Redwood AM, SI Sales, HW Partner Rep
Goal: confirm ownership rules, demo plan, and co-marketing assets
```

priya-si: perfect. operational note: SI will claim inbound leads within 48h and mark SFDC status to `claimed_by_si`. if not claimed, escalate.

marketplace-bot: new listing created: `nucleicloud-redwood-staging` by maria-partners

dan-eng: mapping rules idea: automated workflow — if (ACV > 250000 OR hw_deployed == true) -> assign to queue `SI-CoSell-Nuclei`. else -> sales queue. Alex can you implement?

alex-sdr: yes, I'll create the SFDC automation. plan: owner = queue: SI-CoSell-Nuclei, slack notify #partnerships, email notify sales@redwood.com. will reference rule id 98765 once live.

sophia-sales: can we add an escalation if SI doesn't claim within 72h? route back to sales lead + partners ops.

maria-partners: agreed. escalation path: SI queue -> partners lead -> regional sales lead. we'll codify it in the playbook.

alex-sdr: opened SFDC rule 98765, set owner = SI-CoSell-Nuclei, added email and slack notify. testing now.

priya-si: small ask — for deals <100k but with strong HW match, SI should be allowed to opt-in. set `si_opt_in` = true if they choose to own.

maria-partners: we'll add that. opt-in still subject to 48h SLA and final sign-off by partners ops.

sophia-sales: also request a shared drive for joint collateral + a standard demo deck. maria can you provision?

maria-partners: done — folder created: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1nuclei-redwood-joint (access: partners + sales + si).

dan-eng: for announcement timeline: brand needs final message lock by Friday. pinging brand and legal today.

maria-partners: thanks — i'll update the co-sell playbook with rules, templates, and the SFDC rule id. will post final doc in #partnerships by EOD Friday. :rocket:

marketplace-bot: reminder: announcement draft due in 3 days.

sophia-sales: thanks all — this should reduce churn on lead ownership. we'll run a 1-week pilot after launch to validate routing and SLAs.

maria-partners: pilot sounds good. will schedule a 30m ops retro in two weeks.
